svg.title: Un comando che si adatta
svg.desc: Controlled schematic illustration using authentic glyph outlines shaped with HarfBuzz. Source fonts, whole OFL licences, hashes, variation locations and complete text runs are recorded in manifest.json. Not a browser screenshot, loading-time measurement, working website, physical zoom test or WCAG conformance claim. No glyph substitution, geometric deformation or clipping. Editorial caption and rights remain external native text.
